additional_info.subject: Additional information
additional_info.body: I sent a technician because it had a disjunction which is already more than strange, and he looked at all the safety elements in relation to this error and he found nothing. Can you please intervene on site as soon as possible to solve this problem. And at the same time, I think we really need to identify all the problems this bollard has and eradicate them. There have clearly been too many faults since it was commissioned and this, along with the other faults on our SIEMENS terminals, is affecting our availability percentage.
